name: Glitches and Bitches
source: Vortex City is home to all kinds of people. Cybernetics are common sight even if some of the more purist types would disagree with said practices. The city itself is in a constant state of night due to the pollution that clouds above the city and the weakened atmosphere. The main protagonist, who is renamable, will find herself awakening to the nonstop life of Vortex City. She will discover a strange error that will lead her down a path of mystery, discovery, friendship, and plenty more. Romance can be found in Vortex City if you're willing to look for it. On the other hand, less romantic acts of lust may be just around the corner. You can play the game how you wish in this sandbox environment. It is in visual novel format, but expect plenty of actual gameplay. Although there is plenty of debauchery to get into, there's also a sci-fi based storyline to follow that you just might enjoy.
